claim: Miter can complete the finite operational inheritance of every load-bearing M24, M25, M25.5, M26.0, and M26.3 export required by the PoC, expose every necessary post-26.3 engineering choice as competing provenance-bearing and falsifiable AtomSpace material, and exercise that complete organization through the same persistent assistant before the consented AMA-1.2 Mattermost laboratory is activated.
bounded_claim: One persistent PeTTa/MeTTa organism will carry typed contact, complete finite authority inheritance, Fact9-Flourishing constitutive participation, plural Generated continuations, native movement construction, bounded participant re-entry, consequence-dependent development, and restart continuity. The first live reach remains the exact three-member local Mattermost group and the already-ratified AMA-1.2 capability envelope.
non_claims: R3 does not claim universal actuality reconstruction, metaphysical proof, final Inquiry 26.6 or 26.9 mathematics, universal beneficial outcomes, production readiness, unrestricted multi-user reach, or LLM/PLN/NAL/memory/tool authority. It does not make the build procedure a runtime Soul checklist; does not authorize hidden host-code semantic choices; does not activate Mattermost before Haley's affirmative disclosure consent; and does not reopen or absorb loose G22 or superseded dirty G28 work.
non_claim_list: No finite representation is actuality or a reconstruction of actuality.
No runtime result ratifies, amends, completes, or supersedes the five mathematical authorities or future 26.6/26.9 work.
No score, checklist, first-match table, scenario branch, prompt, or carrier supplies Soul navigation.
No live payload reading, memory admission, model use, or egress occurs before the remaining consent and completion boundaries pass.
No claim is made that every exported theorem is itself an executable operation; theorem-only inheritance must still constrain an actual consumer and have a falsifier.
No unrelated G22/G28 material is staged, repaired, deleted, or incorporated.
rationale: The promoted AMA-1.1 kernel establishes a real finite causal vertical slice, but its own R1 review limits the result to controlled structured fixtures and records unresolved formalization questions. The user requires the PoC to be a faithful, functional laboratory embodiment of M24 through M26.3 and an explicitly provisional exploration surface for 26.6/26.9. Activating now would evaluate a partial Soul; splitting 114 inherited export obligations into independent gates would repeat scaffold and integration work. R3 therefore uses one atlas, one runtime, four additive checkpoints, shared causal test matrices, and one eventual live activation boundary.
human_decision: Berton approved the swift high-fidelity method on 2026-09-05: one integrated R3 procedure, full finite M24-M26.3 implementation, explicit experimental standing for post-26.3 choices, and activation only through that same completed organism. Recorded as D-044.
decision_owner: Berton retains constitutional, acceptance, grant, and ratification authority. Miter retains encounter interpretation, possible-continuation construction, native movement, and consequence-sensitive developmental choice within the authorized runtime. Builders choose neither on Miter's behalf.

representation: A machine-readable 114-row authority completion atlas binds each exported meaning to its native representation, actual persistent-runtime consumer, positive difference, material severance, neutral perturbation, restoration, evidence, limitation, and standing. Native MeTTa modules then implement one cut-bound movement-primary organization. Builder-side JavaScript may generate isolated fixtures and verify evidence but is never imported by Miter or permitted to choose semantic standing. Prolog remains a deterministic effect and persistence membrane.

The phase may change only named versioned cognition, runtime integration, fixtures, verifiers, and R3 evidence. It may read but not mutate the external services during the first three checkpoints. completion_law: R3 cannot close while an operational inherited item is GAP, PARTIAL, fixture-only, or merely named. REPRESENTED-BOUNDARY is permitted only for a genuinely non-executable theorem, non-equivalence, limitation, or jurisdictional boundary whose exact constraint is consumed by runtime cognition or qualification and whose violation has a discriminating falsifier. UNRESOLVED-OBSERVED is permitted only for an honestly open downstream mathematical question, never as a substitute for missing inherited operation. All other load-bearing items must be PROVEN-RUNTIME through the persistent service.
test_economy: Tests are organized by causal seams, not one gate per exported row. One arm may cover several inherited meanings only when the atlas records the distinct expected difference for each and the verifier observes each one. A repeated experiment that neither changes capability nor yields new discriminating evidence is stopped and diagnosed. Failed attempts remain evidence when they falsify a hypothesis or change the route.

laws: No choice gains authority from existence, repetition, retrieval rank, model prestige, or builder preference.
Multiple lawful alternatives remain competing until material discrimination changes standing.
The choice and every standing transition retain exact source and consequence lineage.
A choice may influence movement only through its declared consumer and only while scope-compatible.
Runtime support remains experimental feedback and never becomes ratified mathematics automatically.

continuation_requires: Checkpoint N+1 consumes promoted artifacts and evidence from checkpoint N in the same runtime. Re-freeze is required only if authority, source meaning, external scope, interface contract, final acceptance, or phase dependency changes materially; ordinary implementation repair records a new evidence attempt without rewriting this plan.

After activation, latch the exact grant's panic state, stop only its recorded processes, reconcile pending effects, preserve trajectory/capsules/raw artifacts/admitted memory/receipts/experimental-choice lineage, and restore the last-known-good implementation. External messages are never represented as undone.
